transcript: Environments, shape, shift, and mold us into who we are. The moment the bell begins to alert us, it is time for movement. The more that we silence our internal voice, here it is for us to hear it during emergencies. It is important to be aware, it is important to be still, and it is important to be prepared and ready to move no matter what the circumstance is. Your environment cultivates who we are, and it is important for us to be clear about the way in which we want to walk in this world.
